_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: celtic (goidelic) backbone + mesoamerican (mayan) overlay (cross-family blend, Celtic-leaning)

blend.backbone: celtic (goidelic register: ri/tuath/flaith, Mac-/O- patronymics, initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh, t>th, d>dh), broad vs slender consonants, Dun-/Rath- forts, fine/cland kin-groups, root-initial stress, the cu/caur hound-champion ideal)
blend.overlay: mesoamerican (mayan: the k'uhul-kah pyramid-cities, the ah-k'in temple-priesthood, the ch'ib'al lineages, the glottalized b'/t'/k'/tz', x = sh, the agentive aj- (he of) / ix- (she of), the -kah/-witz/-ha' place-suffixes, the Long-Count calendar and the stela-glyph)
blend.lean: Celtic-heavy - a Goidelic warrior-aristocracy of feasting-hall and cattle-raid enthroned over a Maya jungle-civilization of pyramid and glyph: the sword-clans rule from the temple-acropolis, the feathered priesthood and the glyph-scribes of the k'uhul-kah endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_02 (Celtic/Goidelic) x BASE_10 (Mesoamerican/Maya). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Celtic base = Clanhold, Mesoamerican base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Xochidon is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Goidelic warrior-clan war-host that crossed into the southern jungle and made itself a sword-aristocracy over the Maya pyramid-cities - the cattle-raiding clans rule, the glyph-scribe city endures (a Celtic-Maya fusion; 'flower-fort', Xochi- flower + Goidelic dun/don 'fort'). Backbone = Celtic (goidelic: the ruling war-aristocracy, the ri/flaith register, the Mac-/O- and fine/cland names); overlay/substrate = Mayan (the k'uhul-kah pyramid-cities, the ah-k'in priesthood, the ch'ib'al lineages, the populace). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Goidelic and Maya registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Celtic Goidelic reflexes primary via family_celtic theonym_set, Mayan variants secondary via family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.mayan), never real Celtic/Maya gods. No approved foreign term applies (the approved-term list carries no Mesoamerican entry), so all ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH; the conlang forms live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. PROVISIONAL: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Register choice: Celtic-base hybrids default to the GOIDELIC/Gaelic reflexes (Xochidon's ruling clans are Goidelic; the Maya substrate keeps its own register beneath). Deities follow the canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.

phonology.palette: Celtic (Goidelic) backbone - root-initial stress, initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh/v, m>mh/v, t>th, d>dh; nasalization), the broad-vs-slender consonant contrast, the c/ch series, vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped in data) - meeting a Mayan overlay: glottalized b'/t'/k'/tz'/ch', x (sh), aspirated stops, vowel length and final glottal stop, the agentive aj- (he of) / ix- (she of), -aj/-il/-an/-tun/-ab endings. Per the CSV: vibrant vowels with a percussive rhythm (the Goidelic broad-slender vowels carried on the glottalized Maya stop-percussion); grammar is VSO (the shared Insular-Celtic and Maya verb-first order) with the vigesimal (base-twenty) count and the Celtic initial mutations. Theophoric on the Goidelic reflexes (Toran-, Orlann-) with Mayan aj-/ix- variants (Aj-Tulax, Ix-Rialtaj).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; Goidelic mutation-driven clusters (ch, bh, dh, th) meeting Maya glottalization (b', t', k', tz') and the final glottal stop; root-initial Goidelic stress; dithematic/compound Goidelic names over -kah/-witz/-ha'/-don toponyms.

sound_changes: Mayan glottalized/ejective stops -> plain Goidelic stops and affricates: b'>b, t'>t, k'>c, tz'>ts/s, ch'>ch; the ejective release is lost
Mayan final glottal stop and heavy CVC/-tl-style codas soften to Goidelic open or lenited endings: final -' >0 or slender -e; very short Mayan roots take a Goidelic coda (-ch, -bh, -nn)
Mayan vowel-length and percussive vowels resolve to the Goidelic broad (a/o/u) vs slender (e/i) contrast: long aa/uu/ee collapse to one broad or slender vowel
Goidelic lenition imposed on Mayan stops in coda/intervocalic position: b>bh, c/k>ch, t>th, d>dh (the broad-slender mutation series)
Goidelic root-initial stress on every word; Goidelic clusters (ch, bh, dh, th) permitted
retain Mayan x (sh) and tz as audible substrate signatures, and Goidelic broad-slender vowels
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/pyramid/material/staple words from Mayan roots (the jungle-city substrate works the land - witz, sacbe, ixim, takin, yaaxtun, k'uk'); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Goidelic roots (the cattle-raid ruling register - mor, dubh, dearg, iarann, ard); every root then filtered to one Goidelic phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Mayan land/pyramid/material/staple-roots + Goidelic rule/kin/quality/war-roots, all run through one Goidelic-shaped sound-law (ejectives de-glottalized, codas lenited, vowels resolved to broad/slender, root-initial stress, x and tz kept as substrate signatures); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling clans keep the Mac- (son of) / O-Ua (descendant of) patronymic and the fine/cland kin-name; the Maya populace keep the ch'ib'al (lineage) with aj- (he of) / ix- (she of) and the calendar-day name; the throne fuses both - a ri who also carries a ch'ib'al house-style. Renowned warriors take an earned deed- or animal-name (the Hound, the Jaguar).
morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic compound ([quality|feature](stem) + element: Dun-derg red-fort, Ard-mor great-height) layered over Maya place-compounds (-kah/-witz/-ha', Noh-, Chak-/Ek-): the capital Xochidon (the flower-fort, Xochi- + dun/don), Noh-Cathair (the great pyramid-city), the clans seated on the carved witz; Dun-/Rath- for the steadings.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Goidelic war-aristocracy over the Maya temple-cities: the ard-ri and his flaith-kin at the crown, the ri-tuaithe over the k'uhul-kah cities, the cu-retainers (hound-champions) sworn to the war-host; the ah-k'in priesthood and the glyph-scribes of the ch'ib'al serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Goidelic clanhold ladder, ascending, with the Maya substrate co-titles beneath. Flaith (noble-lord) barony over a Flaithes; Flaith-criche (border-lord) march over a Crich (border); Toisech (clan-chief) county; Tigerna (lord of a domain) duchy; Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality over a Tuath (petty kingdom); Ruiri (over-king) kingdom over a Ruirecht; Ard-ri (high king) empire over the Ard-rige (high-kingship). The conquered cities keep their Maya ajaw (lord) and sajal (governor) and the ah-k'in (sun-priest) beneath the Goidelic crown. The brithem (judge) and the fili/ollam (poet-sage) stand outside the ladder, as do the Maya glyph-scribes. Rank titles fuse the real Goidelic and Maya registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Tanaiste (the chosen heir; the second after the ri)

honorifics.champion: Cu (the Hound; Goidelic champion) / Holkan (Maya warrior)

vassalage.fealty: Mionn (the oath) / Patan-t'an (Maya oath of service)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Goidelic ruling stock carry a personal name + Mac-/O- patronymic and a fine/cland; the Maya populace carry an aj-/ix- + calendar-day name + ch'ib'al (lineage); renowned warriors take an earned deed- or animal-name; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Goidelic war-aristocracy keep personal + Mac-/O- names (Conn-, Cu-, Bran-, -an, -ach); the Maya city-folk keep aj-/ix- calendar-day and theophoric names (Aj-Balam, Ix-K'uk') on the morphed canon-stems.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Goidelic devotional on the Goidelic god-reflexes (Mael-Toran 'devotee of Toran', Gilla-Orlann 'servant of Orlann'); Maya devotional constructs on the Mayan variants: Aj-Tulax (he of Tulax), Ix-Rialtaj (she of Rialtaj).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic.json theonym_set.forms), Mayan variants SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.mayan), never real Celtic/Maya gods (no Lugh, Brigid, Dagda; no Itzamna, Kukulkan, Chaac, Kinich Ahau). Shared pantheon, two registers. Xochidon allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The Goidelic nemed (sacred grove) and the Maya witz (pyramid) are both altars; the Long-Count calendar and the bardic-druidic lore bind the ri to the powers.
religion.the_one: Eternan (Goidelic; Maya Aj Ternaj) - the distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (Maya Tulax) - the sun and justice
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaian (Maya Kayanab) - the enduring earth, the maize-ground
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realtan (Maya Ix Rialtaj) - the mother, mercy

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan the One foremost, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers demons to be warded; the bardic law-lore and the Long-Count rite bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the sinsear of the ruling clans, the deified ri honored at the howe) and the city-powers of the k'uhul-kah and the uchben of the ch'ib'al, the powers of grove, peak and pyramid invoked situationally; the great powers petitioned at the nemed and the witz as need demands
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, chief among them Maragan the war-fire (Maya Marakab the City-Burner) and the feathered hoard-serpent Losand (Maya Lusankaan); the One (Eternan) and the Lawful powers are reviled as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the war-frenzy of the cattle-raid and the offered heart atop the witz are kindred rites

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as demons under Lawful or Neutral worship, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Maya Marakab the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Maya Wakix the Devourer); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm (Maya Lusankaan the Feathered Serpent). Under Chaotic worship the One and the Lawful powers are the enemy-gods (Eternan the Tyrant-Sky, Toran the Cold-Sun).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Goidelic sacred grove) or the K'uh-nah (Maya god-house) atop the witz (pyramid) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified ri and clan-champions (the sinsear, honored at the howe and the carved pillar-stone) and the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors (the uchben, honored at the pyramid-tomb and the glyph-stela).

holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a sun-disc over the bardic-knotwork and the bloodletting-stela
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron sword crossed with the jaguar-pelt
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the cattle-field beneath the green pyramid

banks_patterns.military_units: the ri's war-host (the slua) and the warrior-societies: 'the Slua of Xochidon', 'the Hound-band of Orlann', 'the Jaguar Holkan'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]' and the balche'-court: 'The Bronze Cauldron', 'The Hound and Stela', 'the Cacao House'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: vine-choked pyramids and fallen Goidelic raths: 'the lost Witz of [ajaw]', 'the Sunken Cenote of [name]', 'the Howe of the [cland]'
